cache_state: Reused released Cargo targets and dependency caches; no cold-build claim.

complete_retained_inventory.distribution: Retained privately on native host; full host inventory is excluded from final Git evidence and deliverable archive.

client_startup_record_gap.interval_finding: Only the observed preflight and common job identities were found in this inclusive interval; no additional retained job was observed. This does not settle an unregistered request.
client_startup_record_gap.interval_role: From observed preflight admission to observed common admission; not a proof that an unregistered client request did not occur.
client_startup_record_gap.inventory_authority_scope: Retained identities only; process_status is the authority for individual terminal states. The inventory does not expose idempotency_key fields.
client_startup_record_gap.reason: The original client invocation/rejection record was not retained across agent context compaction. Retained job inventory does not settle whether a pre-admission request was sent or refused.
client_startup_record_gap.replacement_policy: New evidence commit with parent exact S; preserve first G commit and its original pins under a local initial evidence ref. C/E/R/F/S and actual validation artifacts remain unchanged.
client_startup_record_gap.scope: Read-only bounded reconciliation; no request replay, no new tests, no reconstructed original error.
client_startup_record_gap.second_G_replacement_reason: Full host inventory accidentally included in local-only G2 evidence; final G3 excludes the full inventory and is directly parented by S, making G1/G2 unreachable from the publication bundle.

common_validation.scope: S validation process and children only, including failed cargo-deny; excludes prior C/P/U/R validation, S preparation, separate Rust 1.95 clippy, transfer and publication. Per-step costs are nested within total.

excluded: S source edit/freeze and dependency preparation outside the windows
unmeasured controller CPU for separate clippy

preflight.scope: S worktree/input preparation only; excludes later common validation and separate Rust 1.95 clippy. Nested steps not additive.

separate_clippy.scope: Exact original hosted Clippy command on native Linux with Rust 1.95.0; not a hosted CI rerun or browser qualification.
